text:
It really is — 2 AM is no time to be planning a cross-country move, even if the adrenaline of a big life change keeps you up!

Everything will still be here in the morning. When you're ready to pick it back up, I can:

- Build out the **6–8 week calendar of reminders** you can drop into Google Calendar or Apple Reminders
- Finish the **printable one-page Moving Day Essentials** sheet
- Create the **room-by-room packing checklist** with declutter tips
- Put together the **services cancel/start list**

We knocked out the big framework tonight. Sleep well, and safe future travels to Oregon — you, your partner, and the pup. 🐾
